About

Hey there! My name is Jay and I’m an MS Candidate in Computer Science and aspiring Software Engineer. I’m working on learning a wide range of technologies, with a current focus on iOS, specifically Swift, and Python backend development. I’m familiar with C, Java, MATLAB, VBA, Ruby, PHP, JavaScript, SQL and Objective-C.

Currently looking to intern in the NYC area - check out my resume here!

My previous career was in Supply Chain and Operations, and I had the opportunity to work at two incredible companies - PepsiCo and L’Oreal. At PepsiCo, I filled a brand new role as a Supply Chain Analyst on a new team and was exposed to an opportunity to develop data-driven solutions for aggressive business challenges. The tools that I built and shipped continue to be used by employees across North America. At L’Oreal, I was a Manufacturing Planner and managed three global contract manufacturers, producing a combined 1,000,000 units of L’Oreal product per month (talk about compexity!).

I earned my B.S. in Biomedical Engineering from Rutgers University, where I was also an Undergraduate Resarch Associate at the Rutgers University Center for Cognitive Science. I wrote software in MATLAB and C++ to support the research and studies of researchers and Ph.D. students in the Laboratory for Vision Research and Sensory-Motor Integration Lab. Here’s a video of one of our studies in action! I was also involved in student government, serving as president of the School of Engineering’s Governing Council in my fourth year.

Please be sure to reach out and say hey - looking forward to connecting!
